Leo chose a fish, big and simple, and sketched it on the pad: one line over the back, one under the belly, crossing at the tail. He gave Priya the top line and took the belly himself. Priya went for a big load of dominoes, and Tom and Maya kept the bin stocked. Maya checked the nose split and offered to take the rest of the top line. Priya declined, and Leo spotted a problem at the crossing: "the join is turning too sharply right where you're working." Maya then carried the top line from the crossing down to the lower tail tip. Leo said the whole run connected, and the team went hands off. When the start domino fell, all 112 of 112 went with it.
